Thank you for speaking at or organizing a HAMi community event!
This issue tracks getting your materials into the community archive
(`hami-meetup/`, `talks/`, or `webinar/`).

### Event

- Event type:
  - [ ] Meetup
  - [ ] Webinar
  - [ ] Conference talk
  - [ ] Other:
- Event name:
- Date (YYYY-MM-DD):
- City / venue (for in-person events) or platform link (for online events):
- Talk title:
- Talk language: 
  - [ ] English
  - [ ] Chinese
  - [ ] Other:

### Speaker(s)

Name, GitHub handle, and affiliation for each speaker:

1.

### Materials

- [ ] Slides attached as **PDF** (convert PPTX/Keynote to PDF — the archive stores PDF exports only)
- [ ] Slides file name follows the archive convention (no date suffix inside per-event directories)
- [ ] Recording link (if available):
- [ ] Event page / agenda link:

### Publishing consent

- [ ] I confirm I am the author of these materials (or have the author's permission) and agree to have them published in the Project-HAMi/community archive
- [ ] The materials contain no confidential or third-party-restricted content

A maintainer will review this submission and add the materials to the archive.
